Stone

Back to materials database

Quick answer

Collect loose stone on your ranch first. Current official notes also say normal rock gathering outside the ranch does not trigger a police chase; a reliable respawning source is still unverified.

How to get it

  1. Start with loose stones on your ranch. Current-build reports say this visible supply can eventually be exhausted.
  2. If you need more, normal rock breaking outside the ranch is covered by the official 0.8.10.868 temporary no-chase change. Exact deposits and respawning are not recorded.

Where to look

  • Your ranch: loose stone on the ground, supported by current-build player reports.
  • Outside the ranch: normal rock gathering is covered by the official temporary no-chase note, but no exact deposit list is retained.
  • Mines: not available in the reviewed Early Access build; do not treat them as a current supply route.

Main uses and linked content

For a building requirement, use loose stone on your ranch first. If you need more, the official no-chase rule covers normal rock gathering outside the ranch; exact deposits and respawn behavior are not established.

Related quest objectives

  • Axe, Pick & Welcome!
    • Have at least 15 Stones in your inventory.
  • Drop & Earn, the next day!
    • The objective asks for Wood Logs and Stones in the Cash-In box; its configured condition checks whether the box has an item awaiting sale.
  • Chicken Coop Mission
    • Collect 15 stone.

These are the quests’ own configured objectives; they are not purchase prices, sell prices or quest rewards.

Linked quest recipes

  • From Blueprint to Bed · Red Tent × 4
  • Feathered Foes · Scarecrow × 1

These links come from existing recipes registered on quest entries; quantities are recipe records, not quest delivery amounts.

Uses in building entries

  • Coop × 15 (recorded shop offer)

What to do next

  1. Open the linked recipe or building entry and check its Stone quantity before gathering; recipe quantities are not quest hand-in amounts.
  2. For Axe, Pick & Welcome!, keep 15 Stones in your inventory for its configured check. If your visible ranch supply is gone, repeatable replacement supply remains unverified.

Prices and rewards: recorded separately

Acquisition evidence and source boundary

  • Current-build players report gathering loose stone from ranch land and eventually exhausting the visible supply. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Crime system (current-build stone reports) · August 2026 community scan: charcoal, zirconite and stone threads · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Official 0.8.10.868 notes say cutting trees or breaking rocks outside the ranch no longer triggers a police chase, as a temporary change while dedicated gathering areas are developed. This does not establish rules for taking loose items or every ownership interaction. Official

    Source: Official update 0.8.10.868: temporary Trees & Rocks change · Build: 0.8.10.868 (temporary gathering change)

  • A July 2026 player report warned that taking stone from land you do not own could trigger fines or jail. It predates the 0.8.10.868 change and does not establish the current rule for normal rock gathering; other theft interactions remain unverified. Single-source lead

    Source: Steam thread: Crime system (current-build stone reports) · Build: 0.8.10.x, before 0.8.10.868

  • Reliable repeatable Stone supply is still being verified. Mines are not available in the reviewed Early Access build. Official

    Source: Steam thread: Questions about the game (official moderator answer) · Build: 0.8.10.x
